verdict.rationale: YYLO orchestrates coding agents through task worktrees, kanban-driven work items, and iteration loops (run-until-completion, subagent tasking) that could be pointed at a bug-fix task, and it supports ingesting GitHub issues into kanban as a trigger. However there is no evidence of autonomous bug diagnosis (root-causing, log/trace analysis) as a distinct capability — the docs describe generic task/workflow orchestration and merge/validation boundaries rather than an end-to-end 'diagnose then fix' agent behavior. missing for 10: explicit diagnosis/root-cause capability, an end-to-end bug-fix case study or hands-on validation, evidence the agent itself (vs. the orchestrator) performs debugging reasoning.
